title: Advance-Purchase Rule for Crestline Companion Fares
content:
**Rule.** The fare the holder pays for a companion on a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes booking starts from how far ahead the booking was made, counted in calendar days from the entry date of the most recent companion booking on the certificate or pass to its travel date, the entry date excluded and the travel date included:

| Days from booking entry date to travel date | Starting fare |
|---|---|
| 21 or fewer | the companion base fare plus a close-in supplement of 20 USD |
| 22 to 59 | the companion base fare as published |
| 60 or more | the companion base fare multiplied by 0.9, rounded half up to the cent |

## Hypothetical cases (companion base fare of 119 USD)

| Booking entered | Travel date | Days | Starting fare |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 22 June | 21 | 139.00 USD |
| 1 June | 23 June | 22 | 119.00 USD |
| 1 June | 30 July | 59 | 119.00 USD |
| 1 June | 31 July | 60 | 107.10 USD |

For a companion base fare of 99 USD booked 60 or more days ahead the starting fare is 89.10 USD; the close-in supplement is the same 20 USD whatever the base fare.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
